content: Papuru kemɨtihɨritɨariekai teɨteri memɨkahuriyutsixi wahetsiemieme
'Ayumieme nenewieri Kakaɨyari nekaniupitɨani. Ne Papuru nekanihɨkɨtɨni kemɨ'ane Kɨritsitu Ketsutsi hetsiemieme nemanutahɨiya xeme xemɨkahuriyutsixi xehetsiemieme.
Xɨari xepu'enana kenemɨtiuhɨritɨarie, Kakaɨyari 'aixɨa tiuka'iyarikaku. Mɨpaɨ nepɨtiupitɨarie xehetsiemieme.
Xepu'enana kemɨtiuyɨ kepauka nemɨtiuta'ɨkitɨarie tita mɨti'awietsiekai hepaɨtsita. Kakaɨyari yɨkɨmana matsiɨkɨme kanayeitɨani. Mɨpaɨ ne'utaitɨ 'etsiwa nepɨtixe'uta'utɨiri.
Kenemainekai, xe'iterɨwatɨ xekaniyɨwaweni xemɨtemaikakɨ kenemɨtimaiwe 'ikɨ niuki mɨ'awietsiekai Kɨritsitu mukuxata hepaɨtsita.

Meripai teɨteri memanutikɨ wa'utɨma miemete, 'ana mɨpaɨ mepɨkate'ɨkitɨariekai teɨteri, hikɨ matsi nɨ'ariekate memupatsie, meta Kakaɨyari niukametemama, mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mepɨte'ɨkitɨarie 'Iyari yatiwahekɨatɨakaku.

Mɨpaɨ mepɨtehetima, teɨteri memɨkahuriyutsixi huriyutsixi wahamatɨa yaxeikɨa wahetsie pɨtinake, xeiwaiyari mepakɨ huriyutsixi wahamatɨa, 'axeikɨa mepeixeiya tita huriyutsixi memɨte'utahɨawarie kename meheixeiyanikekai mɨkɨ. Kɨritsitu Ketsutsi hetsie metewiyatɨ mɨpaɨ mepu'itɨarie niuki 'aixɨa manuyɨnekɨ.
Neri mɨkɨ niuki hepaɨtsita nepuhɨritɨarie Kakaɨyari kemɨnetiumi 'aixɨa tiuka'iyaritɨ, yɨtɨrɨkariyakɨ kemɨnetiuyuitɨa.

Merikɨ tsepa yunaime Kakaɨyari teɨterimama wahepaɨ nemɨkamariwe, 'aixɨa tiuka'iyarikaku mɨpaɨ nepɨtiumikie, niuki 'aixɨa manuyɨne nemɨwakuxaxatɨwanikɨ hipame nuiwarite mɨpaɨ ne'utaitɨ, Kɨritsitu waɨkawa kemɨrexeiya, katiyu'inɨatsinɨakame.

Mɨpaɨta nepɨtiumikie, nemɨtiwahekɨatsitɨiyanikɨ yunaime tita Kakaɨyari mɨtiyurienikekai. Mɨpaɨ pɨkatimatsiɨkɨkai, katini'awietsiekaitɨni matsi matɨaripaitɨ. Kakaɨyari naime mutiunetɨa, mɨkɨ xeikɨa mɨpaɨ katinimaikaitɨni kemɨtiyurienikekai, yakatini'awietakaitɨni
matsiɨkɨtɨ mayanikɨ hikɨ, memɨyutixexeɨriwa yametehekɨatakaku, mɨkɨ muyuawitsie memɨte'aita heitserie memexeiya yamemɨtehetimanikɨ, mɨiremekɨ kemɨtimaiwe Kakaɨyari, tahetsie yatimatsiɨkɨkaku.
Mɨpaɨ tiyurienike, yapɨtiyɨkɨhɨawekai meripaitɨ, mɨpaɨta katinaye'atɨani Tati'aitɨwame Kɨritsitu Ketsutsi yatiyurienekaku.
Mɨkɨtsie tetewiyatɨ heitserie tekanexeiyani temitahɨawekɨ teyutatuatɨ, 'aixɨa 'iyarikɨ temaye'axɨanikɨ hɨxiena, yuri temɨte'eriekɨ hetsiena.
'Ayumieme nepɨxewawirie xemɨkawaɨripiekakɨ ne'uximatɨariekaku xehetsiemieme. Mɨpaɨ nemɨ'itɨariekɨ, 'ayumieme xepaye'axɨani witsixe'anenetɨ xemakɨnekɨ.
Nenewieri 'epetsutari wahetsiemieme
'Ayumieme nekaniutitunumakeni nenewieri ne'ipitɨanike Tati'aitɨwame Ketsutsi Kɨritsitu 'ukiyarieya.
Mɨkɨ meha'eriwatɨ yunaitɨ nuiwarite yamekatenitetewaka kwiepa memɨtama meta muyuawitsie memɨtama.
Nepinenewiya, mɨkɨ waɨkawa kemɨrexeiya witsiti'aneneme, mɨxepitɨanikɨ yemekɨ xemɨtɨrɨkariyarienikɨ yuhetsie 'Iyarieya yatixetɨrɨkariyakaku,
mɨkɨ meta, kexepitɨaka Kɨritsitu xe'iyaritsie mɨyekanikɨ yuri xete'eriekaku. Xeteyukanaki'erietɨ xekenetseiriyarieka, kɨye kemɨtitse'i hananatɨ, kii kemɨtitse'i tetsariyatsie wetɨ.
Mɨpaɨ xeteyukanaki'erietɨ 'axeikɨa xekaniyɨwawekuni xemɨtehetimanikɨ, yunaime Kakaɨyari teɨterimama wahamatɨa, kemakuyewa, kemeutatewa, kemeutitewa meta kemeukatewa, Kɨritsitu kemɨtiyukanaki'erie,
xemimaikakɨ Kɨritsitu naki'eriyaya, tsepa tewi mɨkayɨwe yamɨretimanikɨ. Xeke'utihɨniyarieni, hepaɨna xemɨ'anenenikɨ, Kakaɨyari kemɨ'ane.
Kemɨ'ane mɨyɨwe matsi kwinimieme mɨtiyurienenikɨ tsepa kemɨtitita, tame matsi ketemɨkate'iwawiriewawe ketemɨkateta'iyaritɨawawe, tɨrɨkariyaya kemɨtatikuyuitɨwa,

mɨkɨ hepaɨtsita 'aixɨa meke'utiyuaneni metatsiha'eriwatɨ tame temɨtatixexeɨriwa Kɨritsitu Ketsutsi meha'eriwatɨ, yunaitɨ teɨteri mexi me'anutikɨka tsepanetɨ xeitsienituyari wiyari manuyekɨka. Mɨpaɨ xeikɨa kani'aneni.
